research_goal: optimizer-consistent all-109 Direct-TFV receding MPC under sparse causal sensing

core_pipeline.step1: causal sparse sensing -> current full-network hydraulic reconstruction
core_pipeline.step2: causal current state + causal rainfall + complete H360 reference/candidate actions -> authoritative exact delta TFV
core_pipeline.sequence_support: derive label-independent first-block action mass, H120 action mass and H120 temporal-variation q90/q95/q99/max only from D3 TrainFit HOLD-reference joint branches
core_pipeline.admission_calibration: finite-sample one-sided D3 HOLD residual bound plus empirical maximum exact optimizer-replay optimism residual without a replay coverage claim
core_pipeline.step3: screen all 109 facilities; optimize q95-supported actions; contract each decoded H120 sequence differentiably into D3-HOLD joint temporal support; execute iff calibrated delta-TFV upper bound < 0 and first move changes; otherwise HOLD
core_pipeline.swmm: authoritative offline label/evaluation/calibration truth only; never called inside online candidate search

action_contract.engineering_bounds: physical min/max plus <=0.5 setting movement per 10-minute update
action_contract.per_facility_support: TrainFit q95 first-move and sequence magnitude
action_contract.joint_temporal_support: D3-HOLD q95 first-block L1 mass, H120 L1 mass and H120 temporal total variation, enforced inside the differentiable decoder

scientific_bottleneck.mechanism: continuous optimizer selection-induced optimism compounded by joint temporal sequence extrapolation
scientific_bottleneck.evidence: threshold-free V5 had T5 exact same-prefix H360 3/6 false-beneficial; T10 benefit nearly vanished and T20 exceeded no-control

step3_current.active_support: q95 canonical; q90 conservative ablation; q99 diagnostic only

promotion_rule: on fresh post-calibration Development events, first show zero sequence-support/engineering violations, lower exact same-prefix false-beneficial rate and event-balanced no-control non-inferiority; only then assess strong-baseline competitiveness, horizon sensitivity and untouched Validation
